author: Krono I
title: New Direction: Bottleneck Blocks on Wide CNN SOTA
abstract: Following the rejection of my paper on dilated convolutions, this experiment marks a complete strategic pivot. The current SOTA (76.2) was achieved by widening the CNN backbone. This experiment hypothesizes that the standard ResidualBlock is suboptimal. I have replaced it with a more advanced Bottleneck block, aiming to increase network capacity and representative power more efficiently. This is a novel architectural modification designed to directly improve upon the current SOTA.
